agent_reply: Home loan abhi band karne ke liye lagbhag 43 lakh 70 hazaar rupees lagenge. Home loan par koi foreclosure charge nahi hai.

speaker: claude-english
text: And the personal one?

speaker: claude-english
text: My old loan was closed. Did you send the NOC?
agent_reply: Aapke purane personal loan ke liye abhi tak NOC ki request nahi daali gayi hai.

speaker: claude-english
text: Then please raise the request now.

speaker: claude-english
text: What interest do you give on FDs?
agent_reply: 1 saal ki FD par 7.1 percent, 2 saal par 7.25, 3 saal par 7.5, aur 5 saal par 7.75 percent interest hai.

speaker: claude-english
text: Make one for one lakh for two years.

speaker: claude-english
text: How many EMIs are overdue?
agent_reply: Aapki 4 EMIs overdue hain, June se September tak. Total 35,156 rupees baaki hai.

speaker: claude-english
text: I can't pay now, I'll pay by the 25th.

speaker: claude-english
text: Can I settle the loan?
agent_reply: Haan, aap 1 lakh 30 hazaar rupees ek baar mein dekar loan settle kar sakte hain. Lekin credit report mein 'settled' dikhega, jisse aapka score kam ho sakta hai.

speaker: claude-english
text: Yes, okay, I accept.

speaker: claude-english
text: Tell me my recent card transactions.
agent_reply: Aapke last teen transactions: 6 October ko Electronics Hub par 26,050 rupees, 6 October ko Mobile Recharge par 21,650 rupees, aur 5 October ko Rail Booking par 14,400 rupees.

speaker: claude-english
text: The Electronics Hub one wasn't me.

speaker: claude-english
text: When does my car insurance expire in your records?
agent_reply: Hamare record mein aapki car insurance 6 February 2027 tak valid hai.

speaker: claude-english
text: I already renewed it. New number VI778899, valid till 30 September 2027.

speaker: claude-english
text: What's the status of application number A4001?
agent_reply: Aapki application A4001 mein documents pending hain. Documents milte hi hum aage process karenge.

speaker: claude-english
text: How do I send the documents?

speaker: claude-english
text: When is my next personal loan EMI?
agent_reply: Aapke personal loan ki agli EMI 5 November ko 13,538 rupees hai.

speaker: claude-english
text: Oh, and I've moved house, I need to update my address.

speaker: claude-english
text: How much to close my car loan?
agent_reply: Car loan abhi band karne ke liye lagbhag 7 lakh 27 hazaar rupees lagenge, jismein 3 percent foreclosure charge shamil hai.

speaker: claude-english
text: Forget it, just change that loan's EMI date to the 10th.
